title: Note: the overview - four columns by importance

text: Heard, and it is the right shape. The default AI 2 view becomes four columns that are lists by importance, not by time: needs-you (clearable; the column vanishes when empty), reports (where a night's report lives and nothing pushes it down), landed (recent work, one line each, a bit more verbose), live (what is running, what is queued, the usage windows). A new arrival never moves the top of a column. Written as the first item of tomorrow's AI 2 brief.
